newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Astra holder says 4,200 rupiah good price.
newsitem.headline: Astra holder says 4,200 rupiah good price.

text.p: A shareholder in Indonesia's largest automobile manufacturer PT Astra International considers a price of 4,200 rupiah per share a reasonable valuation of the company, Bisnis Indonesia newspaper reported on Monday.
The comment by businessman Sofjan Wanandi came as rumours abounded that a group to which President Suharto has links could make a general offer for shares in the company.
Wanandi was quoted as saying that 4,200 rupiah was a good price for the shares but stressed that his Gemala Group had not been approached for its stake in the company.
Gemala owns about 20 million Astra shares, or about two percent.
The Indonesian Observer newspaper said the Nusamba group, controlled by timber tycoon Bob Hasan, may make an offer of 4,100 rupiah per share. Astra closed at 3,950 on Friday.
A spokeswoman for Hasan said he was out of Jakarta and could not comment on the newspaper report. She said it was unlikely any offer would be made on Monday.
Nusamba is 80 percent-owned by three foundations headed by Suharto. Hasan, a close associate of Suharto, and the president's eldest son Sigit Harjojudanto own 10 percent each.
